title: Kingly Crafts: The Archaeology of Craft Production in Late Shang China
bibliographicNote: Chapter 2, Bronze Foundry at Xiaomintun Southeast, 2000–2001, and Fig. 2.4, and Chapter 4's discussion of Type II moulds. Southeast is assigned to Yinxu phases III and IV; emerging evidence suggests that some production may extend beyond the Shang–Zhou transition.
